commands.name: /sharpen
commands.description: Deepen and reframe a prompt or rough idea into a sharper rewritten prompt, without acting on it

commands.name: /interview
commands.description: Clarify an idea toward shared understanding, with no fixed next step

commands.name: /grill
commands.description: Pressure-test supplied context until scope and acceptance criteria are agreed, then recommend the next step

commands.name: /investigate
commands.description: Diagnose a problem from evidence and propose a fix with success criteria, without changing code

commands.name: /walkthrough
commands.description: Walk through how a subsystem works now, or what a finished change did

commands.name: /implementation-brief
commands.description: Create a copy-paste-ready implementation planning brief

commands.name: /hive-plan
commands.description: Create a Hive implementation plan from a spec or brief

commands.name: /approve-sync-plan
commands.description: Approve the active Hive plan and sync executable tasks

commands.name: /start-execution
commands.description: Start executing an approved Hive plan

commands.name: /implement
commands.description: Implement the work this conversation scoped as ad-hoc work, with any extra steering you add

commands.name: /merge-to-main
commands.description: Merge the intended work into its main branch, reviewed and verified on the result

commands.name: /council
commands.description: Run a read-only council and synthesize a recommendation

commands.name: /dash-review
commands.description: Review one Git, inline, or local-artifact evidence bundle without changing files

commands.name: /test-audit
commands.description: Audit test outcomes and duplicate coverage without changing files

commands.name: /vuln-review
commands.description: Assess a requested scope for evidenced vulnerabilities without changing files

commands.name: /worklog
commands.description: Read back where the current work stands from its Worklog

commands.name: /handoff
commands.description: Write a self-contained handoff another agent can pick up for the next job

commands.name: /compact-summary
commands.description: Produce a recovery summary for the current OpenCode session
